more_footer: Connectors built into the hub or provided by extensions. Open one to see its status, sign in and change settings.
not_on_hub: The hub doesn't have this connector
hub_side_note: Sign-in is set up in the assistant's configuration (manager.json). This page only shows the status.
delete_archive_title: Delete what {name} saved to the knowledge base?
delete_archive_message: Chats and people from {name} will be deleted from the knowledge base, and “Add to knowledge base” will be turned off. The Inbox and the assistant's {name} lookups aren't affected.
data_footer: Delete removes its chats and people from the knowledge base and its items from the Inbox, and turns off syncing. You stay signed in.
delete_data_message: Chats and people from {name} in the knowledge base and its items in the Inbox will be deleted, and syncing will be turned off. Project summaries will leave them out from their next update.
starting: You can sign in once {name} has started.
waiting_auth: Waiting for you to authorize on {name}…
bind_in_channels: You can also link it in Settings › Channels › {name}.
source_footer: Pick a computer to use its gh sign-in. Device code sign-in doesn't depend on any computer. Switching signs out of the previous one.
source_loading: Checking gh sign-ins on your computers…
device_flow_detail: No computer needed: enter a code on GitHub to authorize
device_flow_footer: The device code authorization is stored encrypted on the hub and forgotten when you switch to a computer's gh sign-in.
imessage_delete: Delete messages saved on the hub
imessage_delete_title: Delete messages saved on the hub?
imessage_delete_message: Messages chats and people in the knowledge base and Messages items in the inbox will be deleted. Messages on that Mac are not affected.
imessage_read_only: Persona only reads and never sends for you; it reads that Mac directly and marks nothing as read.
extension_inbox_on: New {name} items come into the Inbox. This is the same switch as Add to Inbox on the connector's page.
extension_open_hint: Sign-in, status and more Inbox settings
